title: An Empirical Study of LLM-as-a-Judge for LLM Evaluation: Fine-tuned Judge Model is not a General Substitute for GPT-4

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on the LLMBar benchmark, which comprises adversarial test sets pairing a correct answer with an incorrect answer that has better superficial qualities (e.g., more fluent, more verbose) to see if the evaluator incorrectly prefers superficial formatting over actual instruction following and correctness.
